answer: The orchard register is checked at draw time, cedar lists the eligible set, and mirror seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 24 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 24 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. A 185 account operation therefore ties up 36 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
